svg.text: Ransomware claims in Europe · last 6 months
Final dashboard built by the skill (example layout)
ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE · SYNTHETIC NUMBERS · NOT REAL INCIDENTS
country code as returned by sources
labels kept as in the sources
Causality claimed: no. Co-occurrence in time is not proof of cause.
Only DIRECT matches count in strict incident-level totals.
Bars count claims published on leak sites. They are not confirmed attacks.
Bundled history is a baseline. Recent months come from live sources.
A blocked source is shown as blocked. It is never turned into “no match”.
Layout only: all numbers, country values and group labels above are synthetic placeholders.
